newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle light at $71.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle light at $71.00 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady in a light test. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 900 slaughter steers and 100 heifers; 6,400 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 1,500 head of 41 loads of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs
